openings.claim: A shared availability/boundary ledger may distinguish supported localization from timestamp precedence and first-visible-mismatch certainty through manifest-declared boundaries, reporting supported stages or unresolved intervals with surviving citations; feasibility remains unmeasured.
openings.discriminator: Rivals sort timestamps or declare the first visible mismatch earliest. Inverted timestamps can change rival ordering without proving causal order. Missing transform outputs prevent certainty unless surviving evidence supports localization; removal widens intervals only when necessary evidence was lost. First-visible export certainty and supported intervals can differ despite identical mismatch evidence. Keep missingness and chronology uncertainty separate.
openings.probe: Build one shared ledger from supplied records with dictionary-defined artifact matching; compute rival reports by local script without additional manual rereads. Produce six cited reports with next checks, separating observed mismatches from explanations. Apply stipulated random transform-record removals during final review, manifests unchanged, and recompute. Freeze both variants before opening two answer sheets; compare covered answers only, retaining identities of the disjoint three-pair subsets, within twenty additional minutes. Log every manual inspection: maximum twelve per pair and sixty minutes analysis. Inspect available predecessors only with remaining capacity; otherwise state no feasible check.
openings.uncertainty: Manifest order is expected, not execution or causal dependence; absence never proves nonexecution. Dictionary matching and ledger construction must fit supplied resources; stopping caps alone establish neither feasibility nor informativeness. Unequal boundaries alone need not locate earliest divergence. Defeat: unsupported definite earliest claims, stale citations, lost surviving support, or inspection/time overruns. Every definite stage claim needs a supplied record. Blank warnings explain nothing; two answer sheets cannot validate all six pairs. This is a probe, not deployment.
